{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Wool-blend tailored blazer, structured fit, knee-length hem, charcoal gray (#3a4045), heavy woven fabric
Silk blouse with subtle drape collar, relaxed silhouette, hip length, ivory white (#fffff0), smooth satin finish
Tailored wool trousers, straight leg cut, full ankle length, slate blue (#2f4f4f), flannel weave
Ankle boots with a low block heel, rounded toe, mid-calf height, dark brown leather (#3b261c)

This outfit balances professionalism and warmth for a business meeting during snowy weather in frost. The wool blazer and heavy trousers provide essential insulation against the cold while maintaining a polished, neat appearance suitable for the workplace. A silk blouse adds a touch of refined softness that contrasts nicely with the structured outer layers without violating any strict dress codes. The low-heel ankle boots are practical for walking on potentially slippery, salted streets for twenty minutes while keeping your feet warm and dry."}
